propositions: rebar-debug skill does not record the originating ticket (caused_by link) that introduced a defect before closing the bug, causing defect escape rate to be unmeasurable

blame fallback auto-derivation fails to detect unmet-obligation cases where a producer change creates a requirement and a consumer code is never updated, incorrectly charging the defect to old consumer code instead of the introducing producer ticket
the fix site is not always the cause site; mechanical blame only examines paths the fix touched and cannot see producer-side obligation changes missed by consumers
worktree bootstrap via bare git command does not provision virtualenv, causing pre-commit hooks (ruff, mypy) to fail in fresh worktrees
rebar transition close with bare --caused-by flag allows derive_caused_by fallback to add a second guessed caused_by edge even when a proven link already exists
